meta.title: The Connected Vertex: Your AI Integration Roadmap
meta.subtitle: B2B SaaS · From closed-won to invoiced in minutes, not days — and AI-ready in Year 2

challenge.lead: At Vertex's current deal volume, a 48-hour invoice lag defers $400K+ in ARR recognition every quarter — and that number compounds with every manual handoff that fails. Every Closed-Won deal triggers a relay between sales, finance, and ops. The relay fails at least once a week. Renewals surface as surprises instead of pipeline because the 90-day window passes before anyone acts.

cards.label: Deal-to-Invoice Lag
cards.text: Every Closed-Won deal triggers a manual relay: a rep notifies finance, finance logs into NetSuite, someone creates the record. 48 hours. Every time.

cards.label: No Billing Visibility in HubSpot
cards.text: Account managers work in HubSpot. Billing health lives in NetSuite. Reps discover overdue invoices on renewal calls — not 30 days before.

cards.label: Renewal Blind Spots
cards.text: Contract end dates live in NetSuite. Renewal opportunities live in HubSpot. Without automation, the 90-day renewal window often passes before anyone acts.

solution.lead: MuleSoft sits as a managed integration layer between HubSpot, NetSuite, and Slack — translating business events into automated actions without custom code on either system. Native marketplace connectors handle simple field sync; they do not include retry logic, dead-letter queues, or a managed operations layer — meaning integration failures land on your team to diagnose at 11pm.
solution.diagramCaption: DataSkate-managed MuleSoft layer — no code changes required in HubSpot or NetSuite

roi.headline: The business case for moving now
roi.body: At 80 new logos per year, a 48-hour invoice lag represents roughly $400K in deferred ARR recognition per quarter. Each month this relay continues, Vertex defers approximately $133K in revenue recognition and loses an estimated 4.5 finance hours to manual reconciliation — time that does not compound forward once the relay is eliminated. The B2B SaaS industry median for integrated CRM-to-billing is under 4 hours.

journey.headline: Integration Is Stage 1. Here's What Vertex Looks Like at Stage 3.

stage1.label: Phase 1 · Connected
stage1.headline: Closed-Won to Invoiced Without the Relay
items: HubSpot Closed-Won → NetSuite customer + subscription created automatically in minutes
Invoice payment status syncs back to HubSpot — account managers see billing health in the tool they live in
Slack #ops-alerts fires on subscription created, invoice overdue, renewal approaching — no one monitors a dashboard

stage2.label: Phase 2 · Automated
stage2.headline: Revenue Health Monitoring, Automatic Escalations
items: 30-day overdue → HubSpot task + Slack ping to account manager. 60-day → revenue ops. 90-day → leadership flag — all automatic
Renewal opportunities auto-create in HubSpot 90 days before NetSuite contract end — renewal pipeline is always current
Finance runs zero manual reconciliations — billing data flows live between both systems

stage3.label: Phase 3 · Agentic
stage3.headline: Revenue Questions That Answer Themselves
items: Which of Vertex's 80 accounts has an overdue invoice AND no HubSpot activity in 30 days — surfaced every Monday morning before the CSM team opens their queue
Which closed-won deals from last quarter still have no NetSuite subscription created — and how much ARR is sitting unrecognized right now

The weekly finance reconciliation between HubSpot pipeline and NetSuite actuals runs automatically and flags only the deals where the numbers don't match — your team reviews exceptions, not spreadsheets

journey.closingLine: The managed service model turns the ROI calculation into a single line: the cost of staying manual vs. the monthly service rate.

flows.name: Deal-to-Subscription
flows.value: When a deal moves to Closed-Won, MuleSoft creates the NetSuite customer, subscription, and first invoice automatically — eliminating the 48-hour manual relay and letting provisioning begin in minutes.

flows.name: Invoice & Payment Sync
flows.value: Invoice payment status and renewal dates sync back to HubSpot deal records in real time. Account managers see billing health without running NetSuite reports — overdue accounts surface before the renewal call, not after.

flows.name: Revenue Alerts
flows.value: Key billing events — subscription created, invoice overdue, renewal approaching — fire automated Slack messages to the right channels. Ops and revenue teams are notified without anyone monitoring a dashboard.

outcomes.title: 48-Hour Invoice Lag Eliminated
outcomes.body: Finance stops manually creating NetSuite records from closed HubSpot deals. Provisioning begins within minutes of deal close — improving speed-to-revenue and new customer experience simultaneously.

outcomes.title: Renewal Pipeline — Always Current
outcomes.body: Renewal opportunities auto-create in HubSpot 90 days before contract end. Overdue escalations fire at 30, 60, and 90 days. The revenue team stops monitoring and starts acting on a predictable, automated signal.

outcomes.title: AI-Ready Foundation
outcomes.body: Your integrated data layer becomes the foundation every AI agent, automation, and decision-support tool runs on.
